en-GB.ScenarioWelcomeMessage:
This is a quick guide to familiarize yourself with the basic functionality of the control room.
 Want to go through the guide now?
en-GB.ScenarioPersonMessage:
•Date and Time: The current date and time are displayed here.
Status: The current status of the subscriber is displayed here: 'Green - Active', 'Yellow - Inactive'.
•Name: The subscriber's name is displayed here.
•Phone Number: The subscriber's phone number is displayed here.
en-GB.ScenarioContactCardMessage:
This is an interface element that displays information about a specific subscriber.
If you click on the card, detailed information about this contact will open.
If you see that the subscriber's card is blinking green, then the subscriber is receiving a call.
If you see that the card is lit green, then the subscriber is currently talking.
If you see that the card is blinking orange, then the subscriber is currently on hold.
en-GB.ScenarioContactsMessage: Clicking on the button opens a page with a list of contacts and conferences.
en-GB.ScenarioPhonebookMessage: When you click on the button, a page with a telephone directory opens, where a list of subscribers is displayed.
en-GB.ScenarioGroupsMessage:
When you click on the button, a page opens where groups of terminated subscribers are displayed.
 This page is designed for convenient viewing and management of terminated calls.
en-GB.ScenarioHistoryMessage:
Clicking on the button opens a page with a call log.
The page provides a complete history of all calls made and received, both completed and missed. It is designed for easy viewing and searching of call information.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsMessage: The Settings page allows subscribers to customize various settings and features of the application to suit their individual needs and preferences.
en-GB.ScenarioReloadMessage: The "Restart" (or "Update") button is used to update the application.
en-GB.ScenarioExitMessage: The "Exit" button is used to end the subscriber's current session in the application and exit his account.
en-GB.ScenarioPinnedCallsMessage: The "Hanged Calls" block displays a list of all subscribers (calls) that were made using the loudspeaker (Gooseneck) by default. You can also call hung calls using the handset.
en-GB.ScenarioCallManagerMessage: The Conference/Call Control Block is a set of elements that allow the subscriber to control the current call or conference.
en-GB.ScenarioCallQueueMessage:
The Call Queue block displays current calls and calls awaiting an answer.
Note!: The queue will not display calls from contacts assigned to Speakerphone (Hanged Calls block), such calls will change the color indication in the hung calls block.
en-GB.ScenarioRightPanelMessage: A control that allows the subscriber to adjust the audio playback volume for "Ended Calls".
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsMainMessage: The "Basic Settings" section of the application settings provides the subscriber with the ability to configure settings that affect the overall user experience of the application.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsMediaDevicesMessage: In this section you can configure the settings of media devices.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsIncomingCallsMessage: In this section you can customize the behavior of your device when receiving an incoming call.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsContactsMessage: This section is designed to personalize bookmarks in the contacts block with speed dial, which you can use to quickly access frequently used contacts.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsPriorityMessage: This section is designed to personalize the color of the contact in an incoming call.
en-GB.ScenarioSettingsLinesMessage: In this section, you can assign physical buttons on your device to quickly dial contacts. This allows you to easily and quickly call the people you need without going into your contact list.
en-GB.ScenarioCurtainLineDeviceMessage:
In the drop-down list, you must select the device that will be used by default for all curtained lines.
Note: this list is formed from devices with the type "Gooseneck"
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceTypeMessage:
In the drop-down list, you can select the user media device option:
• Gooseneck - responsible for working with closed lines.
• Phone, Headset - responsible for working with calls by default. (The phone can also be used for closed calls, but with limited functionality).
• Other - a user device that does not fit into other available options.
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceModuleMessage:
In the drop-down list, you must select which physical device this setting will apply to.
For example, if the name contains the symbol L1, then this module applies to the first left module of the device.
L2 to the second left module of the device
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceNumberMessage: You can select the device number in the drop-down list. This setting is optional, it is only responsible for displaying the button number on the screen
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceAudioInMessage:
In the drop-down list, you must select the microphone that will be linked to the module.
'Note: If the device name contains L1, we recommend linking it to the L1 module
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceAudioOutMessage:
In the drop-down list, you must select the speaker that will be linked to the module.
Note: If the device name contains L1, we recommend linking it to the L1 module
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceOperatingModeMessage:
This mode only works for the device type: "Gooseneck"
In the drop-down list, you must select the operating mode.
• Stateful mode - Default mode. The button is pressed, the mode is switched.
• Walkie-talkie mode (push to talk) - You must hold the button to talk
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceButtonAppearanceMessa: Allows you to customize the appearance of the button that will be linked to this device
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceAudioInTestMessage: Allows you to check the functionality of the microphone
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceAudioOutTestMessage: Allows you to check the speaker's functionality
en-GB.ScenarioMediaDeviceDeleteButtonMessage: Allows you to remove this device
en-GB.ScenarioContactViewCardDeviceCheckMessag: There is no configured configuration for the call. We recommend going to "Settings" → "Media devices"
en-GB.ScenarioGroupsOfClosedContactsRowMessage:
This row groups the curtained lines at the user's discretion.
Up to 7 participants can be placed in one row.
en-GB.ScenarioGroupsOfClosedContactsFooterMess:
To add a closed contact to one of the groups, press the button,
then press + on any necessary block.
Note: To correctly add a closed contact, you must first assign the subscriber to the speakerphone channel slot.
